sections.title: Acceptance of terms
sections.content:
By accessing or using Everstead ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the Service.

These terms apply to all users of the Service, including individuals, families, and professional advisers.

sections.title: Description of service
sections.content:
Everstead is a secure digital organization platform that helps individuals and families organize accounts, documents, instructions, and wishes for estate planning and family handoff purposes.

Everstead is not a legal services provider and does not provide legal, financial, or tax advice. Nothing in the Service constitutes or replaces advice from a licensed professional.

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account. By registering, you confirm that you meet this requirement.

You may cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period. We do not offer prorated refunds for partial billing periods unless required by applicable law.

sections.title: Consumers in France
sections.content:
If you are a consumer residing in France, contracts for digital services such as Everstead are subject to a fourteen (14) day right of withdrawal (droit de rétractation) under the French Consumer Code (Code de la consommation). Where you expressly request that performance of the service begin before the end of the withdrawal period, that right may be affected as provided by law.

Consumers residing in France may also refer any dispute, free of charge, to a consumer mediator (médiateur de la consommation): [Médiateur de la consommation — désignation en cours]. The mediator's details will be published once appointed.

These terms are drawn up in English and made available in French for convenience. In the event of any conflict or divergence between the two versions, the English version prevails.
